# Three.js browser runtime

Three.js 0.180.0, https://threejs.org/, MIT licensed. See LICENSE in this directory.
The unmodified three.module.min.js and three.core.min.js files come from the
three npm package's build directory. The pinned development dependency and
package lock record the version; these local copies keep static demos CDN-free.

To update, install the intended exact version and copy both build modules plus
LICENSE here. The published player package does not include the demo or Three.js.
